title: Naturality of the ambient coefficient specialization
statement: For any two Coherence presentations over the same exact base pullback, if their degree-zero coefficient isomorphisms commute with given coefficient module maps, their ambient scalar specializations commute with the induced scalarUnderlyingMap on source and target, for every derived object.

source.place: Tags 07A4, 0G7E and 06YU; scalar-unit refinement with sites-modules.tex Tag 03EL; parent proof steps 1–6.

proof.text: The two independently normalized ambient comparisons agree: precompose with representatives of resolving pairs and postcompose with the invertible tensor factorization. Their normalization equations agree; full faithfulness proves uniqueness.
Exact factorization and naturality of the degree-zero single-complex functor transport the coefficient square to the derived category.
Naturality of the ambient tensor comparison at the coefficient morphism gives the specialized square. Conjugate by the normalized scalar tensor presentations and cancel inverse isomorphisms.

proof_origin.place: Explicit formalization of the parent scalar/unit refinement of Tags 07A4 and 0G7E.
